selected_issues.body_for_case: Hello Grafana team, I hope this message finds you well. Why is this needed: Currently, Git Sync in Grafana OSS works mainly with GitHub. Users who manage dashboards in GitLab repositories (cloud or self-hosted) can't take advantage of Git Sync. Adding GitLab support would improve flexibility for users and teams that use GitLab as their version control system. What would you like to be added: Add official support for GitLab repositories in Git Sync provisioning. This includes allowing GitLab repository URLs and access tokens in the configuration (grafana.ini) and updating the documentation with GitLab examples. Who is this feature for? Grafana OSS users and teams who store and manage their dashboards in GitLab repositories and want to use Git Sync ...
selected_issues.title: Add GitLab Support to Git Sync Feature in Grafana OSS

selected_issues.body_for_case:
Why is this needed: 

The configuration of Git Sync should be persisted in configuration files so that it has not to be configured after every deployment.

What would you like to be added:

An option to configure Git Sync in a configuration file that can be copied into a docker image.

Who is this feature for?

For developers running Grafana in a docker container in a cloud environment
selected_issues.title: Make Git Sync configurable via configuration file

selected_issues.body_for_case: Why is this needed: When creating a Grafana-managed recording rule, the recorded metric only starts collecting data from the moment the rule is created. As a result, the new recorded metric lacks historical data. This makes it difficult to ensure that the recording rule is properly configured and valid for SLIs or baseline analysis. For example, if you create a recorded metric for an SLI, there will be no historical data available, forcing you to wait until enough new data is collected to verify correctness or analyze trends. What would you like to be added: Prometheus already supports backfilling via its backfilling mechanisms, that populates recorded metrics with historical data using the promtool tsdb create-blocks-from command: Adding similar support for ...
selected_issues.title: Backfilling for Grafana-managed recording rules
